name: FastMCP Production Server
description: Provides secure filesystem operations, HTTP fetching with SSRF protection, JSON validation, artifact logging, and optional Redis key-value storage through both stdio and HTTP transports. Features production-ready security controls including sandbox enforcement, allowlist validation, and comprehensive input validation.
